Conclusions and Recommendations

Key Findings

  • Rapid growth in L2 fees, active contracts, and new users indicates strong network adoption
  • Transaction metrics show a scalable and efficient network with high success rates
  • User activity patterns suggest a healthy mix of new and recurring users
  • Some contracts are consuming significant gas, which may present optimization opportunities

Recommendations

  • Continue monitoring L2 fee growth and adjust fee structures if necessary to maintain competitiveness
  • Investigate high gas-consuming contracts for potential optimizations or security concerns
  • Implement user retention strategies to convert the influx of new users into long-term active participants
  • Consider scaling infrastructure to maintain high performance as network usage grows
  • Develop and promote developer tools to capitalize on the growing interest in smart contract deployment

Note:

This analysis is based on data from February 1st to February 11th, 2024. As Unichain&apos;s just launched, these trends should be monitored closely over the coming weeks to establish long-term patterns and make more definitive strategic decisions.
